program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((zero-mask (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                      (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 0) 1 0))))
         (zero-objs (objects zero-mask 0)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list zero-objs)])
      (if (empty? (filter (lambda (p)
                            (or (= (first p) 0) (= (second p) 0)
                                (= (first p) (- (rows g) 1))
                                (= (second p) (- (cols g) 1))))
                          (obj-cells obj)))
          (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 7)
          out))))
